title: Describe What You See: Images, Diagrams and Microscopes
objective: Students describe visual biology information without memorizing a long paragraph.
outcomes: Use there is / there are to describe images.
Use location words such as inside, near, around, and at the center.
Describe size, shape, color, and number.
activity: Help your partner draw what you see.
example: When I looked through the microscope, I could see many small cells arranged close together, and most cells had a darker structure near the center.
